sections.overview: It ranges from Eritrea to north-eastern Tanzania.
sections.identification: Its pied plumage and long yellow bill are distinctive.
sections.diet: It eats insects, fruits and seeds.
sections.behavior: It forages on the ground, often in pairs or family groups.
sections.reproduction: It nests in a tree or rock cavity; the female seals herself inside while the male feeds her through a narrow opening.
sections.ecology: It sometimes forages beside dwarf mongooses, which may benefit from its vigilance.
sections.conservation: The latest global IUCN listing available in the cited assessment is Least Concern.
